import ctypes

# Load the libraries in the correct order
ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so', mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
gsl = ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so')

# Define the gsl_multiset structure
class GSL_MultiSet(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_ = [
        ('n', ctypes.c_size_t),
        ('k', ctypes.c_size_t),
        ('data', ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_size_t))
    ]

# Define the function prototype
# int gsl_multiset_next(gsl_multiset * c)
gsl.gsl_multiset_next.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(GSL_MultiSet)]
gsl.gsl_multiset_next.restype = ctypes.c_int

# Function to call gsl_multiset_next
def call_gsl_multiset_next(multiset):
    return gsl.gsl_multiset_next(ctypes.byref(multiset))

# Test cases

def assert_test():
    # Create a multiset
    n = 5
    k = 3
    data_array = (ctypes.c_size_t * k)(0, 1, 2)
    multiset = GSL_MultiSet(n=n, k=k, data=data_array)

    # Test gsl_multiset_next
    result = call_gsl_multiset_next(multiset)
    assert result == 0, "Expected GSL_SUCCESS (0)"
    assert list(multiset.data[:k]) == [0, 1, 3], "Expected data to be [0, 1, 3]"

    # Test edge case where next should fail
    data_array = (ctypes.c_size_t * k)(4, 4, 4)
    multiset = GSL_MultiSet(n=n, k=k, data=data_array)
    result = call_gsl_multiset_next(multiset)
    assert result != 0, "Expected GSL_FAILURE (non-zero)"

if __name__ == "__main__":
    assert_test()
